summary: Topics UX/UI correction aligned to existing stable authority. The generic three-column cover wall is replaced by a single Editorial / Reference Index using the established 豆瓣读书 + Raindrop grammar: title, summary, tags and updated time are primary; real topic covers remain optional supporting context; generic favicon/icon cache and synthetic initial placeholders are not promoted into covers. Desktop, tablet and mobile remain compact list-first. Shared Shell, Navigation, frozen Channels and Watch, other product bodies, data model, schema, migration, auth/security, provider, updater mechanism and Production are unchanged. OWNER_DIRECT_RELEASE applies; Preview and real-use remain post-release/post-production evidence.
